summary: All 5 human lines mark real folds with correct direction and extent; all sit on the concave side at/near a bend tangent line (inner surface), not at the outer apex. M01/M04 stay inside the 4 mm gate; M02/M03/M05 are 5.1-5.7 mm and fail it. No missing formed bends. Not a frame problem (gold on scanned inner surface; no rigid transform maps gold onto any single locus family).

M01.locus: front flange (400 mm, bend ~91 deg): gold at the flange-side bend tangent line, inside the sheet thickness (inner skin mostly unscanned; 0.5-1.3 mm from inner skin), along-bisector +1.9 mm / across +2.1 mm from outer apex

M02.locus: left tab (bend ~66-69 deg): gold on the tab inner surface ~1-2.6 mm past the inner tangent line (nearest raw vertex 0.09 mm)

M03.locus: right tab (bend ~90 deg): gold on the base inner surface 1.7-1.9 mm past the base-side inner tangent (nearest raw vertex 0.09 mm); base outer skin unscanned here

M04.locus: left wall (bend ~90 deg): gold on the inner surface exactly at the wall-side inner tangent (theta 36/45 deg; nearest raw vertex 0.04 mm)

M05.locus: right wall (bend ~107-111 deg, Ri ~4.6): gold on the inner surface at the base-side inner tangent (+0.2 mm; nearest raw vertex 0.12 mm)
